provenance.exposure: User November 5 authorizes duration choice. Continuous imposed heating; milestones 30/60/120/240/480/960 s, stopping on model exhaustion or 960 s. This is not an inferred propellant burn duration.

provenance.cooling_schedule: First cooling second uses five times the heating step; subsequent cooling uses the specified refined ceiling. Exactly one native substep is required per accepted interval.
